a3s.title: Late lab results delay ER discharges
a3s.background: Emergency room patients who need blood work wait for lab results before a discharge decision. Long waits block beds, push up 'left without being seen' rates and hurt patient experience scores. This supports the hospital goal of 4-hour ER length of stay.
a3s.strategicLink: Hospital goal: 95% of ER patients discharged or admitted within 4 hours
a3s.currentText: Observed 3 shifts at the ER and lab (gemba walks 4, 6 and 9 Nov). Average turnaround for routine blood panels is 85 minutes against a 45 minute standard. 62% of samples wait more than 20 minutes for pickup at the ER. Night shift is the worst.
a3s.problemStatement: Routine ER blood panels take 85 minutes from order to result, 40 minutes over standard, on about 120 samples a day. Most of the delay is between the draw and arrival at the lab.

goal.statement: Cut average ER routine lab turnaround from 85 to 45 minutes by 31 March 2027, for blood panels drawn in the ER.

whys.why: Results are late because samples reach the lab 35 minutes after draw
Samples sit in the ER waiting for the porter's hourly round
The pneumatic tube station is at the far end of the ER, so staff batch samples for the porter
Tube station location was set before the ER was extended in 2023

a3s.rootCauses: Sample transport depends on an hourly porter round because the only tube station is out of the staff's walking path.

countermeasures.name: Add a second tube station near beds 12 to 20
countermeasures.cause: Tube station far from the walking path

countermeasures.name: Send each sample when drawn (no batching)

followup.checkPlan: Weekly turnaround report from the lab system, reviewed at the Monday huddle. Mentor review on 31 March.
followup.standardize: Send-when-drawn added to ER standard work. Tube station use added to new-starter induction.
followup.yokoten: Share with Urgent Care and the Day Surgery unit, who use the same porter route.
followup.lessons: Timestamping each step early showed that the delay was transport, not testing.
